**Ruled: Option B — formalize the seam.** The synthesizer output (`deriveFieldGroupDetailSections`, `splitPrimarySecondary`, the grouped branch) becomes an explicit, named, **typed** second input to the record-details renderer (separate node type or branded internal prop); the bare `s.title ?? s.label` coalescing disappears. Spec side unchanged; no re-parse regression. Option A stays recorded as the eventual endpoint if the re-parse cost is ever accepted; ⛔ Option C stays rejected.

**Source-thread check performed before recording** (the migration note's precondition — objectstack#6639 read in full): **B was already ruled by the maintainer on 2026-08-08** (comment 5225534248, under the verbatim directive 「你的建议全部接受」), with the same rationale (zero authoring pull for `title`; the two-shape reality written into the type system; the AI learn-wrong-spellings channel closed). The card migrated here carrying its ruled `pm:queue` state; the 2026-08-17 escalation back to the decision box was made without reading the source thread's ruling. Today's 「同意」 is therefore a **re-confirmation — double provenance, no conflict**; no prior hold/restart condition on the source thread contradicts it.

For the objectui seat: the source-thread ruling was always binding — a migrated card's history lives on the source issue, and the migration note said so. Dispatchable now. Label flipped `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in the same stroke.
